instructions: Contact page: 'Muziek voor op KINK? plug@kink.nl'.

name: FluxFM Neu (FluxFM)
instructions: FAQ 'Wie landet meine Musik im Radio?': write to radar@fluxfm.de, subject "Musikpromo"; the music team replies if the songs fit the FluxFM programme.
notes: Saves from Spotify playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Station-owned 'FluxFM Neu' new-music playlist. Route is the station FAQ (general music submissions + FluxFM Radar newcomer show), not playlist-specific; no domestic-only restriction stated.

name: Best New Indie (Scruff of the Neck Records)
instructions: Label homepage: "Artist Submissions - please fill out the form here scruffoftheneck.com/submit" (redirects to a Google Form, 'Scruff of the Neck - Artist Contact Form'). Playlist: "The hottest new artists, discover your new favourite here."
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Features non-roster new indie acts (The Lilacs, Florence Road, Do Nothing, Nieve Ella). Form resolves to https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfYudpzmSJu-o_ACM1AYbPFbVFQM89YB89kDjNpPSQxkX3uWg/viewform. Form is a general label artist-contact form, not playlist-specific. Owner: Spotify user sotnrecords.

name: egoFM Soundcheck: Die neuesten Songs der Woche (egoFM)
instructions: FAQ: bands email Julian and Sebastian in the egoFM music team with a link to the song and a little band info; no AI music.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). The FAQ (sourceUrl) invites bands to email Julian and Sebastian of the Musikredaktion with a song link and band info, pointing to the team page (egofm.de/ueber-uns/team), where their addresses sit behind a JS-cloaked mailto and are not in plain page text, so email is left null here. Weekly new-adds playlist; includes UK acts. Method set to none-found because no address is shown on the FAQ page itself.

name: The Great Escape Festival 2027
instructions: Apply to play via the artist application form; free, no CD Baby account needed. Applications open until 15 Feb 2027; no reply by 31 Mar 2027 means unsuccessful.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Apply-to-play page links both the form and this playlist. Lineup playlist: tracks added once acts are booked. No email route.

name: Left of the Dial 2026
instructions: Artist applications 2027 via the form page; it's password-protected, and the password instructions are in the pinned post on their Instagram. Don't email applications.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Showcase festival 'with the best new bands'. Page says info@leftofthedial.nl must NOT be used for applications. Deadline (1 May 2027) seen only on a secondary source. No fee stated.

name: WKNC's Hottest Tracks Now (WKNC 88.1, NC State)
instructions: WKNC no longer accepts emailed submissions; use the music submission form with a Dropbox or Google Drive link (WAV preferred, MP3 OK, shareable permissions). YouTube/SoundCloud/Spotify links won't be considered. Note any FCC violations; clean edits help.
notes: 117 saves read from the Spotify playlist page, 12 Nov 2026. The playlist description says it is a regularly updated showcase of the hottest tracks the station is currently playing. Indie rock submissions go to the daytime music director (Lindsay Day, per wknc.org/about/contact/), but submissions must go through the form only. The contact page links a different Google Form (1FAIpQLSchoiz...). I used the one on the music page. No local-only restriction is stated.

name: PNKSLM'S HITS OF THE WEEK! (PNKSLM Recordings)
instructions: Label contact page: "Submissions, demos etc: info@pnkslm.com (please note we try to listen to everything but we're not able to respond or provide feedback for everyone)". Playlist itself is weekly-updated tracks from the PNKSLM team and guest curators.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Email is a label demo inbox, not a playlist-pitch inbox; pitch as a demo and mention the playlist. Weekly guest curators pick tracks beyond the roster. Description last referenced a Clutter EP 'out April 11th', so rotation may have slowed.

name: PICKS OF THE WEEK (Specialist Subject Records)
instructions: Label contact page: "we very much welcome submissions, we listen to everything we're sent... Please send a private streaming link (e.g. Soundcloud / Youtube) and some details on what your plans and hopes are for your music. Don't worry about sending us a fancy press kit, don't worry if it's unmastered." Notes they release few records a year and can't always reply.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Playlist: "Our favs from this week at Specialist Subject. Updated Regularly." Features non-roster artists (The Courtneys, Propagandhi, Anna Burch, Television Personalities). Email route is the label's demo inbox, not a playlist-specific pitch address.

name: Selector DMs (Selector Radio, British Council)
instructions: "Send your music to Selector Radio at the email address below for your chance to get it played, by Sian Eleri, on the show." Email or DM on socials; must be UK-based; keep it clean.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Playlist collects tracks sent in by artists and played on the show. Email and UK-only rule are on the British Council 'get your music played' page, which also embeds this playlist. Show is eclectic new UK music, not rock-specific.

name: Green Man 2026
instructions: Send artist submissions to artists@greenman.net (the 'Artist submissions' button on the contact page).
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Contact page has an 'Artist submissions' mailto (artists@greenman.net) and links Spotify user greenmanfestival, owner of this playlist. Lineup leans indie/folk/psych; no specific instructions given.

name: Reeperbahn Festival 2026
instructions: 'As a band or artist you can apply via the form below' (Artist Submission form on the page).
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Submission page links this playlist. Form titled 'Artist Submission 2026'; check it has rolled over to 2027 before applying. No fee seen.

name: 88Nine's Discover Music Weekly (88Nine Radio Milwaukee)
instructions: Send uncompressed audio (WAV preferred), mixed and mastered, radio edits required, no physical media, plus a document with bio (all musicians' names), comments about the song, full lyrics, upcoming album/live info and links. They listen to everything but can't guarantee airplay or give feedback.
notes: 667 saves read from the Spotify playlist page, 12 Nov 2026. The playlist collects songs the DJs bring to the weekly music meeting, so the route is the station's general airplay form (Formstack, embedded on radiomilwaukee.org/music-submission), not a direct playlist pitch. The page sets no local-only rule. 88Nine is an AAA/indie public station.

name: Spotify Monthly Playlist (95bFM)
instructions: Email with a streaming link AND a lossless download link (no Spotify/password-locked links); include artist, song, release date, where you're from; short bio only; send by release day.
notes: Saves from Spotify playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Student station; plays international music but NZ-leaning. Playlist title still reads 'February 2025' so may not be refreshed monthly any more; submission is for station airplay.

name: Heet van de Naald (Urgent.fm)
instructions: Contact page, Muziekredactie: 'Info over playlisten of muziek doorsturen? muziek@urgent.fm'.
notes: Saves from Spotify playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Community/student station's daily-picks playlist by its music desk; eclectic rather than rock-focused. No Belgian-only restriction stated.

name: Amazing Radio Playlist (Amazing Radio)
instructions: "Upload your music to Amazing Radio, playing 100% new and emerging music. Get played on air and featured on our playlists." (via the amazingtunes.com uploader)
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Playlist mirrors the station's core rotation. Route is the artist uploader on amazingtunes.com; amazingradio.com itself is JS-only and could not be read. Search snippets (unverified) suggest one free upload with paid tiers for more, so check before uploading. Update date not visible.

name: Not All Girl Bands Sound the Same (Specialist Subject Records)
instructions: Playlist description: "Updated semi-regularly with my favourite new non-bloke bands. Recommendations welcome: info@specialistsubjectrecords.co.uk"
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Curated by Kay of Specialist Subject. Only for bands with women/non-male members; fit depends on FloodLines' line-up. Features many non-roster punk/indie bands (Scrunchies, Moontype, Blowout).

name: Anchored To Rock (Anchor Eighty Four Records)
instructions: Label site: playlist 'showcases some of the best signed and unsigned talent from the ROCK music community. We open up the playlist once a month for new submissions via our Facebook and Instagram pages'; spots are limited. Separate demo policy: send a short intro, why you want to be on the label, and a Bandcamp/SoundCloud/YouTube link (no MP3s) to demos@anchoreightyfour.com; not via a manager; listens to everything, no guaranteed reply.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Playlist adds go through the monthly open call on IG @anchoreightyfour / Facebook; the email is for label demos, not playlist adds (demo policy on https://www.anchoreightyfour.com/about). The description lists big names (Bad Omens, I Prevail, Sleep Token), so it leans heavier than FloodLines.

name: FOCUS Wales 2025
instructions: Performance applications open May to 1 Nov each year; not accepted by email. Currently closed (reopens May 2027).
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Information page states the application window and the 'will not be accepted via email' rule; apply link absent while closed. A third-party apply link seen in a directory was not used.

name: ESNS 2027

notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Eurosonic showcase for European new acts. Closed now: plan for the March 2027 window.

name: CAN'T SK8 FOR SH*T (KATSTAR Records)
instructions: CAN'T SK8 FOR SH*T: rock, punk, pop-punk, reggae and ska; English-language songs; no covers, instrumentals, dub or AI; avoids religion/politics and overly morbid or sexual lyrics.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). KATSTAR (est. 2020) says it 'discovers, supports, and distributes music for artists outside the major labels'. Route is paid Groover; profile promises top-15 placement for at least a month if accepted. Skate-punk leaning, so a stretch for FloodLines. Country not stated.

name: THE PNKSLM HIT FACTORY (PNKSLM Recordings)
instructions: Label contact page: "Submissions, demos etc: info@pnkslm.com (please note we try to listen to everything but we're not able to respond or provide feedback for everyone)".
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Roster-only playlist ('HITS HITS HITS from PNKSLM Recordings'); a place here needs signing/release via the demo inbox. Same inbox as the Hits of the Week row; send one email only.

name: Anchored to Pop Punk (Anchor Eighty Four Records)
instructions: Label site: 'showcases some of the best signed and unsigned talent from the Pop-Punk music community. We open up the playlist once a month for new submissions via our Facebook and Instagram pages, that fans and bands can send music to for consideration.' Updated weekly, with limited spots.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Route is the monthly open call on IG @anchoreightyfour / Facebook; demos@ is the label demo address (https://www.anchoreightyfour.com/about). Pop punk only (Taking Back Sunday, The Story So Far), so a weak match for indie/alt.

name: Specialist Subject - New Releases (Specialist Subject Records)
instructions: Label contact page invites demos: "Please send a private streaming link (e.g. Soundcloud / Youtube) and some details on what your plans and hopes are for your music."
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Roster-only playlist ("Latest songs from Specialist Subject Records"); a place here only follows a label signing. Same inbox as the other Specialist Subject rows, so send one pitch.

name: RM ~ Recently (Royal Mountain Records)
instructions: Demos page: 'Please send any and all demos to info@royalmountainrecords.com'. Send streaming links only (ideally SoundCloud or Bandcamp), no attachments and no long PDF bio. Say when you are playing in Toronto. They listen to everything but reply only if interested, so don't follow up. Sending several demos is fine.
notes: Followers are Spotify saves shown on the playlist page (12 Nov 2026). Roster-only playlist ('latest releases from Royal Mountain'), so the realistic route is a label demo, not a playlist add. Label acts include PUP, Alvvays and Mac DeMarco. Toronto label that cares a lot about live shows, which makes it hard for a UK band.
